title: 开始阅读最后更新：2026-07-06 20:37:01 最新章节：第158章 两个难题
slug: 方士开局我给秦始皇画大饼
content_zh:
公元前212年，深秋某天，兴乐宫内。
肃穆压抑的空气中，只有微弱的喘息和衣料摩擦青砖的窸窣声。
邹云跪倒在丹墀上，瑟瑟发抖。
在他身边，一同跪俯的还有四百六十多名同事。
而在他们周身，数队身披玄色重甲、腰悬青铜长剑的秦宫锐士，正虎视眈眈盯着这群罪人。
甲士手中弩箭上闪过的寒芒，宣告着灭亡六国的战功，也昭示着脚下这群人的结局。
而邹云，就蜷缩在人群后方，身旁都是一些面色惨白，乳臭未干的面孔。
他下意识挪动一下，屁股上传来的刺痛，提醒着他如今的残酷现状！
邹云实在是想不明白，自己不过是与好友小聚，一起吃着火锅唱着歌，怎么眼睛一闭一睁，就莫名其妙的跑到这里。
还莫名其妙的，马上就要和身旁的四百六十多名同事，以如此悲壮的姿态，一同名留青史了！！！
‘不是，这对吗？’
‘我承认，每个人心里，都或多或少有着名留青史的野望，但也不能，是作为被焚书坑儒的方士，来载入史册吧！！！’
‘系统呢？救一下啊！！！’
就在邹云绞尽脑汁，试图找到类似金手指存在的时候。
突然，一声撕心裂肺的吼声，在他耳边炸起：
“陛下冤枉啊，冤枉啊陛下！！！！”
邹云浑身一个激灵，下意识看向声音来源。
那个挣扎着起身，试图爬起来的家伙是冯吉，前身记忆里，最喜欢溜须拍马的家伙。
而他的高呼，就跟刚穿越过来，鬼哭狼嚎的自己一样，瞬间触怒一旁守卫的大秦锐士。
黑色铁塔般的身影，循声跨步上前，硕大拳头狠狠砸在冯吉脸上。

“噗！”
铁拳与脸颊相遇的瞬间，宛如天雷勾动地火，立刻炸开了花。
冯吉口中喷出血沫和碎牙，整个人重重摔回地面。双目无神，口中还是含糊不清的喃喃道：
“陛...陛下......冤...枉啊......”
‘竖子，可笑！’
看着这家伙的惨状，平日里被他仗势欺辱过的方士，都忍不住在心底叫好。
众人在甲士冰冷的目光下，向冯吉撇了一眼便迅速低下头，继续等待自己未知的结局。
不过，冯吉这一闹也不是没有好处的。
这突如其来的骚动，终于惊动了那个高踞丹墀之上，主宰着所有人命运的巍峨身影！
“将他带上来！”
低沉、平稳、却不怒自威的声音，在众人耳边清晰回响。
“唯！”
那名甲士浑身一震，瞬间收敛所有戾气。
不敢有丝毫耽搁，甲士双手捧心，身体微弯，朝着陛下深深作揖行礼后。
这才拽着神色恍惚，如同烂泥般的冯吉，一步步朝台阶上走去。
‘时机到了！’
沿途看到冯吉的方士，眼底闪过一丝精光，神情瞬间活络不少。
这群方士不认为冯吉这个蠢物，能改变始皇帝的想法。但始终一言不发的秦皇开口了，这就是他们等待许久的转机。
很快，冯吉就被拽到高台之上，这还是他头一次见到皇帝的真容。
虽然不敢直视皇帝陛下，但他还是忍不住偷瞄了一眼。
content_en:
In 212 BC, one day in late autumn, in Xingle Palace.
In the solemn and oppressive air, there was only the faint sound of breathing and the rustling of clothing against blue bricks.
Zou Yun knelt down on Danqi, trembling.
Beside him, there were more than 460 colleagues kneeling together.
Around them, several groups of Qin palace warriors wearing heavy black armor and hanging bronze swords at their waists were staring at these criminals with eager eyes.
The cold light flashing on the crossbow arrows in the hands of the soldiers announced the victory of the six kingdoms, and also showed the fate of the group of people at their feet.
Zou Yun, on the other hand, was huddled at the back of the crowd, surrounded by pale, wet faces.
He moved subconsciously, and the stinging pain on his butt reminded him of his current cruel situation!
Zou Yun really couldn't understand. He was just getting together with his friends, eating hot pot and singing songs. Why did he end up here inexplicably as soon as he closed and opened his eyes?
It’s still inexplicable that he and more than 460 colleagues around him will soon be remembered in history with such a tragic gesture! ! !
‘No, is this right? ’
‘I admit that everyone has more or less ambitions to be famous in history, but it cannot be recorded in the annals of history as an alchemist whose books were burned and Confucianism was humiliated! ! ! ’
‘What about the system? Help! ! ! ’
Just when Zou Yun was racking his brains, trying to find something like a golden finger.
Suddenly, a heartbreaking roar exploded in his ears:
"Your Majesty is wronged, Your Majesty is wronged!!!!"
Zou Yun's whole body trembled, and he subconsciously looked towards the source of the sound.
The guy struggling to get up was Feng Ji. In the memory of his predecessor, he was the guy who liked to flatter others the most.
And his shouting was just like the one who had just traveled through time, crying like a ghost and howling like a wolf, instantly angering the Great Qin Rui warriors guarding the side.
The black iron tower-like figure stepped forward following the sound, and hit Feng Ji hard on the face with his huge fist.
"Poof!"
The moment the iron fist met his cheek, it was like thunder stirring up earthly fire, and it exploded immediately.
Feng Ji spurted blood and broken teeth from his mouth, and fell heavily back to the ground. His eyes were dull, but he still muttered vaguely:
"Your Majesty... Your Majesty... you are wronged... in vain..."
‘Shuzi, that’s ridiculous! ’
Seeing this guy's miserable state, the alchemists who had been bullied by his power on weekdays couldn't help but applaud in their hearts.
Under the cold gaze of the soldier, everyone glanced at Feng Ji and quickly lowered their heads, continuing to wait for their unknown ending.
However, Feng Ji's trouble was not without its benefits.
This sudden commotion finally disturbed the majestic figure who stood high on Danqi and controlled everyone's destiny!
"Bring him up!"
The low, steady, but not angry voice echoed clearly in everyone's ears.
"Yui!"
The soldier was shocked and instantly restrained all his anger.
Not daring to delay at all, the soldier held his heart in his hands, bent his body slightly, and bowed deeply to His Majesty.
Then he dragged Feng Ji, who looked dazed and muddy, and walked up the steps step by step.
‘The time has come! ’
The alchemist who saw Feng Ji along the way had a glimmer of light in his eyes and his expression became lively in an instant.
This group of alchemists did not think that Feng Ji, a fool, could change the First Emperor's mind. But Emperor Qin, who had always remained silent, spoke. This was the turn they had been waiting for for a long time.
Soon, Feng Ji was dragged to the high platform. This was the first time he saw the true face of the emperor.
Although he did not dare to look directly at His Majesty the Emperor, he could not help but take a sneak peek.
